info.title: payment-api
info.description: The payment HTTP routes and OpenAPI contract over the chain-neutral wallet and index abstractions. An asset is its network's own asset id (`native`, or a token); no chain or asset is named in this contract.

get.summary: Read readiness and network health from memory
get.description: Public memory-only readiness: ready when at least one network is configured and no network's last indexing step failed. No RPC or storage reads.
The contract every route is generated from; public, like the health routes.

500.description: The contract could not be encoded

get.description: Every asset of every configured network, with its metadata. This is the only list of assets the wallet routes accept.
The job's outcome and how many transactions it signed and the nodes accepted.

get.summary: List every configured network, its indexing and its stored RPC nodes
get.description: Every network the configuration names, what its indexer did since the process started, and the nodes stored for it. Only each node's origin is returned.

503.description: The stored nodes could not be read

put.description: Stores the nodes, then sends every later call of the network (indexing, wallets, broadcast) to them, failing over in order; calls already sent finish on the node they reached. The nodes are not verified here: the chain verifies them on the next start, which uses the stored list whatever the configuration file says. Credentials in the URL are stored as sent.

503.description: The nodes could not be stored

post.description: Stores a trigger on a configured network. Its `id` is chosen here and never changes.

400.description: Malformed body, id or action address

post.summary: Preview what a trigger would see now
post.description: Without storing anything: the wallet indexes the selector picks at the last kept block, fully indexed, with balances, and whether the filter and check hold for a trigger that never ran. A fee in the filter or check is estimated.

503.description: The store, node or estimator is unavailable

put.description: Replaces everything but its id and creation time; a body `id` is refused. Setting `enabled` to false pauses it.

404.description: No such trigger, or network not configured

delete.summary: Delete a trigger and its runs

get.description: Every keyed wallet and watched address, in wallet ID order.

post.summary: Generate a wallet, or watch an address, in one configured network
post.description: Without `address`, generates a wallet and stores it with its key; keys never leave the server and HTTP accepts none. Retrying creates another wallet. With `address`, watches that address without its key. Either way the address is then indexed in every asset of `assets` from `start`; watching an asset already watched keeps its first start.

404.description: Network or asset is not configured

503.description: Generation, the node or the store is unavailable

get.description: The wallet's network, canonical address, whether it is keyed, and the assets it is indexed in; never its key.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: `<chain>:<network>:<address>`, as a create call returned it.

get.summary: Read a wallet's balance in one asset
get.description: The total of every indexed movement of the address in `asset` over every kept block (unconfirmed ones included), in display units, with how far the address is indexed and the chain's tip. A watch-only address reads the same way.

parameters.name: asset
parameters.description:
An asset id of the wallet's network (`GET /v1/assets`); default
`native`.

404.description: Network or asset is not configured

put.description: Tags the address; tagging twice keeps one tag. Any address of a configured network can be tagged, keyed or not.

404.description: No such tag, or network not configured

get.summary: Read one page of a wallet's history
get.description: The wallet's transactions in `asset`, in chain order, with only its own movements of that asset; a fee is shown where this address paid it in the native asset. Block rewards count in the balance but are not transactions.

parameters.name: asset
parameters.description: An asset id of the wallet's network; default `native`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` of the previous page; absent for the first page.

400.description: Malformed wallet ID, query, cursor, or limit

404.description: Network or asset is not configured

post.summary: Enqueue an ordered send from a wallet
post.description: Enqueues one send job of `asset` from the keyed wallet: its transfers are signed up front and broadcast in order. A 202 response means queued, not submitted: `GET /v1/jobs/{id}` reports the outcome. Indexing records the transactions once they are mined, for the assets the wallet is watched in. A watch-only wallet answers 422.

400.description: Malformed body, wallet ID, amount, or destination

404.description: Network or asset is not configured

503.description: The queue or store is unavailable

Asset.description: Metadata of the asset an amount is denominated in.

decimals.description: Decimal places between atomic and display units.

id.description: Asset ID within the chain (`native` or a token identifier).

name.description: Display name, when known; always present.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, when known; always present.

assets.description: Assets in network, then id, order.

Balance.description:
A wallet's balance in one asset over every block kept so far.

Blocks are kept up to the chain's produced tip, so `amount` includes
blocks the chain may still take back; a reorg archives them and the
amount follows.

amount.description:
Exact display units, e.g. `12.5`; negative, e.g. `-0.5`, when indexed
debits exceed indexed credits (history before the start is unknown).

indexed_through.description:
Native position the address is indexed through in this asset; null
before its first block or when it is not watched in it. Always present.

tip.description:
The chain's produced tip at the indexer's last step; null before the
first. Always present.

Block.description: The block a transaction was mined in.

hash.description: Block hash, hexadecimal, in the chain's native byte order.

timestamp.description: Unix seconds, when the chain reports one; always present.

ConfiguredNetwork.description: One configured network, its indexing, and its stored nodes.

indexing.description: What its indexer did since the process started.

nodes.description:
Stored nodes in failover order; null while the network uses its
configuration file's nodes. Always present.

CreateWallet.description:
`POST /v1/wallets` body: generate a wallet in one network, or watch an
address in it without its key.

address.description:
Address text in any form the chain accepts. Present: watch this
address without its key. Absent: generate a new wallet.

assets.description: The asset ids to index it in; absent means `["native"]`.

start.description:
Where indexing begins: `"fresh"` for the chain's tip, or the native
position to index from. Absent means `"fresh"`.

DetailedEndpoint.description: A node with its own bounds.

bounds.description:
Per-call limits: `timeout_ms`, `max_request_bytes`,
`max_response_bytes`; each defaults when absent.

url.description: `http` or `https` URL naming a host, without a fragment.

ErrorBody.description:
The body of every error response: `message` is always present, the
failing transfer's index only when one transfer of a send failed.

failed_index.description:
Zero-based index of the transfer that failed. Present only when one
transfer of a send failed.

Indexing.description: One network's indexing health, from memory.

error.description: The last failure, cleared by the next kept block; always present.

last.description: Native position of the last block kept; always present.

reorgs.description: Kept blocks archived because the chain took them back.

tip.description: The chain's produced tip at the last step; always present.

accepted.description: How many of them, in broadcast order, the nodes accepted.

reason.description:
Why it failed, or why its last attempt is being retried; always
present.

Listing.description: One configured asset: its id, where its wallets live, and what they hold.

asset.description:
The id every wallet route's `asset` takes within `network`: `native`,
or a token's chain-owned id.

network.description: The chain and network this asset's wallets live on.

Movement.description: One movement of the wallet's asset inside a transaction.

index.description: Its order among the movements shown.

MovementKind.description: What a movement did to the wallet.

Network.description:
The chain and network a wallet, address, or transaction belongs to. It
always ships as one nested object, never as two sibling fields.

indexing.description: What its indexer did since the process started.

networks.description: Networks in chain, then name, order.

Report.description: The memory-only health snapshot of this process.

ready.description: At least one network, and none whose last step failed.

oneOf.description: The node's URL, with default bounds.

RpcEndpoint.description:
One RPC node, written as the configuration file's `endpoints` writes it.
The URL carries any credentials: userinfo (HTTP Basic) or query keys.

RpcNode.description: One RPC node as it may be shown.

origin.description:
Scheme, host and port of the node's URL. User information, path and
query are never returned: any of them may hold a credential.

endpoints.description: One to 16 nodes, in failover order.

Selected.description: One wallet index a selector picked.

pending.description: Not yet confirmed change in display units; negative when leaving.

wallet_id.description: `<chain>:<network>:<address>`, as the wallet routes take it.

Send.description:
`POST /v1/wallets/{id}/transactions` body: an ordered send from the
path's wallet in one asset.

asset.description: An asset id of the wallet's network; default `native`.

Start.description: A wallet's birthday on the wire: `"fresh"` or a native position.

wallet_id.description: `<chain>:<network>:<address>`, as the wallet routes take it.

tags.description: Every tag, by network, address, then tag.

Transaction.description: One transaction of a wallet's history.

block.description: The block it was mined in.

movements.description: The wallet's movements of the asset.

reason.description: Why it reverted, as the chain reported it; always present.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor of the next page; null on a short page. Always present.

transactions.description:
At most `limit` transactions in kept blocks, in chain order. Kept
blocks reach the produced tip, so the last ones may still be taken
back by a reorg.

TransferItem.description: One ordered transfer of a send.

amount.description: Exact positive decimal in display units.

destination.description: Recipient address text, as the wallet's chain writes it.

check.description:
When it acts: `"idle"`, `{"since": {"seconds": …}}` and compares under
`all`/`any`/`not`.

filter.description:
Which of them it acts on: compares under `all`/`any`/`not`; null:
every one.

selector.description:
Which wallet indexes it acts on: `{"ids": […]}`, `{"asset": "…"}`,
`{"tag": "…"}`, `{"all": […]}`, `{"any": […]}`, `{"not": …}`.

TriggerDefinition.description: A trigger as written: `POST` (with `id`) and `PUT` bodies.

id.description: Its slug; `POST` only (`PUT` takes it from the path).

TriggerPreview.description: What a trigger would see now.

check.description: Whether the check holds for a trigger that never ran.

confirmed.description:
The block position balances are read at; null before the first
block. Always present.

filter.description: Whether the filter holds; null without a filter. Always present.

selected.description: What the selector picks, fully indexed, with balances.

settled_at.description: Unix ms; null while a send is in flight. Always present.

Wallet.description: One wallet's public metadata; never its key.

assets.description: The asset ids it is indexed in.

keyed.description: Whether this server holds its key and can send from it.
